task: Create a segment named "internal_staff" that matches users whose trait "email_domain" equals "shop.example".
finalText: DONE: Created segment `internal_staff` (ID 32) in project "shop" with the rule "All of the below: email_domain EQUAL shop.example". I verified it with `segment get` and `segment list`. No flags, overrides, or environments were changed.
commands: flagsmith segment list 2>&1 | head -30; flagsmith segment get --help 2>&1 | head -20

cat > /tmp/rules.json <<'EOF'
{"type":"ALL","conditions":[{"property":"email_domain","operator":"EQUAL","value":"shop.example"}],"rules":[]}

flagsmith segment create internal_staff --rules @/tmp/rules.json --description "Users whose email_domain trait equals shop.example" 2>&1; echo "exit=$?"; flagsmith segment get internal_staff 2>&1; flagsmith segment list 2>&1
